issues.detail: The Greek text mentions 'σμυρναν' (myrrh) as a distinct item. The Vietnamese translation combines 'nhũ hương' (frankincense) and 'nhựa thơm' (myrrh/resin), but the phrasing 'nhựa thơm một dược' is confusing and potentially misses the specific distinction of the two different resins mentioned in the Greek.
